input_contract: Given an array nums of integers and an integer target, return indices of the two different elements whose sum equals target. If no such pair exists return an empty list.

variants.name: Brute Force
variants.strategy: Examine every unordered pair of indices and return the first matching sum.

variants.name: Hash Map
variants.strategy: Use a hash map to store seen numbers and their indices, and look up the complement in O(1) per element.
